The Router's assessment of 'structural_collapse' (severity 3) regarding text alignment is also supported by the visual evidence of wavering lines and floating characters. No new artifacts were found by experts that contradicted the Router; rather, they reinforced the text failure.
alignment_reasoning: The image receives a very low alignment score. Although the 'fine_grained_classifier' predicted 'menu' (likely due to texture/layout priors), the image fails the core definition of the class: a listing of food/beverage items. artifact_reasoning: The artifact score is low (poor quality) primarily due to the catastrophic 'text_gibberish' artifact (Severity 5). For a document-based class like 'menu', legible text is a structural requirement, not just an aesthetic one. The AI generated pseudo-text that collapses under scrutiny. Additionally, there are minor texture anomalies and spatial grounding issues with the ink lines (Severity 2-3). The combination of unreadable text and slight layout warping results in a significant penalty.
